name: Hamburger Soup
subtitle: From Grandma Kemper
notes: This soup is always better the 2nd day.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Cook until brown: **1 pound hamburger** and **2 medium onions**.

steps.title: Add the rest
steps.body: Add **1 quart tomatoes**, **3 cups water**, **2 medium carrots**, **2 ribs celery**, chopped, **¼ cup ketchup**, **¼ cup pearl barley**, **1 Tbsp beef bouillon**, **1 tsp seasoned salt**, **1 tsp dried basil** and **1 bay leaf**.

steps.title: Boil or bake
steps.body: Boil or bake for 1 hour. Salt and pepper to taste.
